name: 52-week high on heavy volume
author: claude
hypothesis: Stocks closing within 1% of their 52-week high on 1.5x their usual turnover, near the day's high, in an uptrend and a healthy market, keep rising for two weeks (52-week-high anchoring).
filter: dist_hi252 > -{near} and turn_ratio_5_60 > {vol} and close_loc_1 > 0.7 and ma50_over_ma200 > 0 and nifty_above_ma200 == 1 and not avoid
